releaseNotes: Refactor server settings UI and improve SFTP details handling
changelog: Updated layout styles for sidebar disconnect buttons to use transparent backgrounds.
Enhanced serverTabs.js to create a two-column layout for server settings, improving organization and readability.
Refactored PteroAppBar.kt to simplify icon button handling and removed unnecessary composition locals.
Improved ServerSettingsScreen.kt by introducing dedicated components for server renaming and SFTP details, enhancing code readability and maintainability.
Added new strings for editor functionalities in Arabic localization.
